Indicator Name: Average time taken for initial assessment of patients admitted in IPD
Definition: Mean time elapsed in minutes from admission registration until initial assessment completion.
Numerator: Sum of initial assessment time (minutes)
Formula: (Sum of initial assessment time) / (Total IPD admissions)

Indicator Name: Percentage of IPD patients for whom initial assessment was completed within defined timeframe
Definition: Proportion of inpatients whose initial assessment was completed within hospital defined policy timeframe.
Numerator: Inpatients assessed within defined timeframe
Formula: (Inpatients assessed within timeframe / Total IPD admissions) * 100

Indicator Name: Average time taken for initial assessment of patients coming to emergency
Definition: Mean duration in minutes from emergency registration arrival until triage completion.
Numerator: Sum of emergency assessment times (minutes)
Formula: (Sum of emergency assessment times) / (Total emergency patients)

Indicator Name: Percentage of emergency patients for whom initial assessment was completed within defined timeframe
Definition: Compliance percentage of emergency patients triaged and assessed within policy limits.
Numerator: Emergency patients assessed within triage timeframe
Formula: (Emergency patients assessed within timeframe / Total emergency patients) * 100

Indicator Name: Percentage of in-patients wherein plan of care with desired outcomes is documented and countersigned
Definition: Proportion of inpatients having a structured care plan detailing clinical goals and physician counter-signature.
Numerator: Inpatients with documented and countersigned care plan
Formula: (Inpatients with valid care plan / Total audited inpatients) * 100
Data Source: Nursing Care Plan Tab & RMO Handover Tab

Indicator Name: Percentage of in-patients wherein screening for nutritional needs has been done
Definition: Proportion of admitted inpatients screened for nutritional risk within 24 hours of admission using MNA-SF.
Numerator: Inpatients screened for nutritional needs <= 24h
Formula: (Nutritionally screened inpatients / Total inpatients admitted) * 100
Data Source: Nursing Assessment MNA Section & Mini Nutrition Tab

Indicator Name: Incidence of patient falls (Patient Fall Rate per 1,000 patient days)
Definition: Number of recorded inpatient fall incidents per 1,000 occupied bed days.
Numerator: Total patient fall incidents reported
Formula: (Total patient falls / Total inpatient bed days) * 1000
Data Source: Incident Reporting System & Morse Fall Risk log

Indicator Name: Incidence of bed sores after admission (Hospital-Acquired Pressure Injury Rate)
Definition: Proportion of vulnerable inpatients who developed a new Stage II+ pressure injury after admission.
Numerator: Patients who developed new pressure ulcers after admission
Formula: (Patients developing new pressure ulcers / Total vulnerable inpatients) * 100
Data Source: Pressure Ulcer Assessment Tab & Braden Risk Log

Indicator Name: Incidence of patient rights violations and formal grievances
Definition: Rate of verified patient rights complaints or formal written grievances per 100 admissions.
Numerator: Total verified grievances / rights violations
Formula: (Verified grievances / Total admissions) * 100

Indicator Name: Incidence of needle stick injuries (NSI Rate per 1,000 occupied bed days)
Definition: Frequency of occupational sharp/needle stick injuries reported by healthcare staff per 1,000 bed days.
Numerator: Total needle stick / sharps injuries reported
Formula: (Total NSI reported / Total inpatient bed days) * 1000
Data Source: Occupational Health / HICC NSI Incident Log

Indicator Name: Medical record completion rate (Incidence of incomplete medical records)
Definition: Percentage of discharged medical charts containing all notes, summaries, and signatures within 48h.
Numerator: Total complete medical records on discharge audit
Formula: (Complete medical records / Total audited discharge charts) * 100
Data Source: MRD Audit Register & EMR Completion Tracker

Indicator Name: Percentage of non-compliance observed related to infection control practices
Definition: Proportion of infection control audits where safety lapses were detected.
Numerator: Infection control practice violations observed
Formula: (Infection control violations / Total checkpoints monitored) * 100

Indicator Name: Patient satisfaction rate of the inpatient wards (IPD Satisfaction Index)
Definition: Overall satisfaction percentage expressed by discharged patients.
Numerator: Sum of positive satisfaction scores
Formula: (Total positive satisfaction score / Total maximum possible score) * 100
Data Source: Patient Feedback Form / Digital Survey System

Indicator Name: Time taken for discharge (Discharge Turnaround Time in hours)
Definition: Mean time elapsed in hours from consultant writing discharge order until bed is vacated.
Numerator: Sum of discharge turnaround time (hours)
Formula: (Sum of discharge turnaround hours) / (Total discharges)

Indicator Name: Average nurse-patient ratio in each shift (ICU & General Wards)
Definition: Average number of assigned patients per on-duty staff nurse across shifts.
Numerator: Total active inpatients during shift
Denominator: Total qualified nurses on active bedside duty
Formula: Total patients on shift / Total bedside nurses on duty

Indicator Name: Percentage of adverse drug reactions (ADR Reporting Rate)
Definition: Proportion of admitted inpatients who experienced an adverse drug reaction.
Numerator: Number of patients who suffered verified ADRs
Formula: (Patients with ADRs / Total admitted patients) * 100

Indicator Name: Medication error rate (Prescription, Transcription, Dispensing, Administration)
Definition: Number of reported medication errors per 100 doses administered.
Numerator: Total medication errors identified
Formula: (Total medication errors / Total doses administered) * 100

Indicator Name: Percentage of medical records audited for clinical review
Definition: Proportion of closed inpatient records reviewed by Clinical Audit Committee.
Numerator: Closed medical records audited by clinical committee
Denominator: Total patient discharges in that month
Formula: (Audited medical records / Total patient discharges) * 100
Data Source: Clinical Audit Committee Minutes & Sampling Log

Indicator Name: Unplanned readmission rate within 30 days for similar diagnosis
Definition: Proportion of discharged patients who returned for unplanned readmission within 30 days.
Numerator: Unplanned readmissions within 30 days
Formula: (Unplanned 30-day readmissions / Total prior discharges) * 100
Data Source: EMR Admission Registry with UHID Linkage

Indicator Name: Percentage of adverse anaesthesia events
Definition: Incidence of adverse events occurring during or immediately post-anaesthesia.
Numerator: Total adverse anaesthesia events recorded
Formula: (Adverse anaesthesia events / Total anaesthesia procedures) * 100

Indicator Name: Percentage of re-scheduling or cancellation of elective surgeries
Definition: Proportion of planned elective surgeries on master OT list cancelled or postponed on surgery day.
Numerator: Planned elective surgeries cancelled on scheduled day
Denominator: Total elective surgeries scheduled on OT list
Formula: (Cancelled surgeries / Total scheduled surgeries) * 100
Data Source: OT Master Schedule & Daily Operative Log

Indicator Name: Compliance rate to surgical safety practices (WHO Surgical Safety Checklist adherence)
Definition: Percentage of surgeries where all 3 phases (Sign In, Time Out, Sign Out) were documented.
Numerator: Surgeries with 100% complete surgical safety checklist
Formula: (Surgeries with completed safety checklist / Total surgeries) * 100

Indicator Name: Percentage of surgical cases who received prophylactic antibiotic within specified timeframe
Definition: Proportion of indicated surgical patients who received IV antibiotic <= 60 mins before incision.
Numerator: Surgical patients receiving antibiotic <= 60 mins of incision
Denominator: Total surgical cases indicated for prophylaxis
Formula: (Cases receiving antibiotic <= 60 mins / Total indicated cases) * 100
Data Source: Anaesthesia Record & eMAR Pre-Op Medication Log

Indicator Name: Percentage of blood transfusion reactions (Adverse Hemovigilance Rate)
Definition: Incidence of adverse blood and component transfusion reactions per 100 transfusions.
Numerator: Adverse transfusion reactions reported
Denominator: Total blood and component units transfused
Formula: (Adverse transfusion reactions / Total units transfused) * 100
Data Source: Transfusion Reaction Log & Blood Bank Register

Indicator Name: Turnaround time (TAT) for the issue of blood and blood components
Definition: Average time in minutes from requisition receipt in blood bank until cross-matched issue.
Numerator: Sum of time taken (minutes) for all blood issues
Formula: (Sum of blood issue turnaround minutes) / (Total requisitions)

Indicator Name: Percentage of blood component usage
Definition: Proportion of transfusions administered as separated components rather than whole blood.
Numerator: Total units of blood components transfused
Denominator: Total units of whole blood plus components transfused
Formula: (Blood components transfused / Total blood & components) * 100

Indicator Name: Turn-around time for laboratory tests (Routine & Stat Tests)
Definition: Average time in minutes from sample collection until laboratory results verification.
Numerator: Sum of time elapsed (minutes) for all lab tests
Formula: (Sum of lab turnaround minutes) / (Total investigations)

Indicator Name: Turn-around time for diagnostic radiology (X-Ray, CT, Ultrasound)
Definition: Mean time in minutes from imaging examination completion until signed radiologist report.
Numerator: Sum of time elapsed (minutes) for all radiology reports
Formula: (Sum of radiology turnaround minutes) / (Total imaging exams)

Indicator Name: Catheter-Associated Urinary Tract Infection (CAUTI Rate per 1,000 catheter days)
Definition: Number of hospital-acquired CAUTIs per 1,000 indwelling urinary catheter days.
Numerator: Total CAUTI cases meeting NHSN criteria
Formula: (Total CAUTI cases / Total urinary catheter days) * 1000

Indicator Name: Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia (VAP Rate per 1,000 ventilator days)
Definition: Incidence of healthcare-associated pneumonia in patients ventilated > 48h, per 1,000 vent days.
Numerator: Total VAP cases diagnosed by NHSN criteria
Formula: (Total VAP cases / Total ventilator days) * 1000

Indicator Name: Central Line-Associated Bloodstream Infection (CLABSI Rate per 1,000 line days)
Definition: Laboratory-confirmed bloodstream infections with central line > 48h, per 1,000 line days.
Numerator: Total CLABSI cases identified
Formula: (Total CLABSI cases / Total central line days) * 1000

Indicator Name: Surgical Site Infection (SSI Rate per 100 clean surgeries)
Definition: Incidence of surgical site infections occurring within 30 days of surgical procedure.
Numerator: Total surgical site infections identified in surveillance
Formula: (Total SSI cases / Total surgical procedures) * 100
Data Source: OT Log, Surgical Notes & Follow-up Clinic

Indicator Name: Gross Hospital Mortality Rate
Definition: Percentage of all hospital deaths occurring across all admitted patients.
Numerator: Total deaths occurring in the hospital during period
Denominator: Total hospital discharges plus deaths in period
Formula: (Total hospital deaths / Total discharges and deaths) * 100

Indicator Name: Net Hospital Mortality Rate (Deaths occurring > 48 hours after admission)
Definition: Proportion of inpatient deaths occurring strictly after 48 hours of admission.
Numerator: Total deaths occurring after 48 hours of admission
Denominator: Total hospital discharges and deaths in period
Formula: (Deaths after 48 hours / Total discharges and deaths) * 100

Indicator Name: ICU-Specific Mortality Rate
Definition: Proportion of patients admitted to the Intensive Care Unit who died while in the ICU.
Numerator: Total patient deaths occurring in ICU
Formula: (ICU deaths / Total ICU admissions) * 100

Indicator Name: Unplanned return to ICU within 48 hours of discharge to general ward
Definition: Proportion of patients stepped down from ICU who unexpectedly returned within 48 hours.
Numerator: Patients readmitted to ICU within 48h of step-down
Denominator: Total patients transferred out/discharged from ICU
Formula: (Unplanned ICU returns within 48h / Total ICU transfers out) * 100
Data Source: Patient Transfer Tab & ICU Bed Log

Indicator Name: Rate of return to emergency department within 72 hours with similar presenting complaints
Definition: Percentage of emergency discharges who returned unscheduled within 72h with similar complaints.
Numerator: Patients returning to ER within 72h with similar symptoms
Denominator: Total patients discharged from emergency department
Formula: (Returns to ER within 72h / Total ER discharges) * 100

Indicator Name: Unplanned re-intubation rate within 48 hours of extubation
Definition: Proportion of mechanically ventilated patients requiring re-intubation within 48h of extubation.
Numerator: Unplanned re-intubations within 48 hours of extubation
Formula: (Unplanned re-intubations within 48h / Total extubations) * 100
Data Source: ICU Flowsheet Ventilator Log & Procedure Log

Indicator Name: Percentage of unplanned return to Operation Theatre (OT) during same admission
Definition: Percentage of surgical patients who required an unexpected second operation during same stay.
Numerator: Surgical patients with unplanned return to OT
Formula: (Unplanned returns to OT / Total operated patients) * 100

Indicator Name: Percentage of near-miss incidents reported
Definition: Proportion of total incident reports that represent near misses caught before reaching patient.
Numerator: Total near-miss occurrences reported
Formula: (Near misses reported / Total incidents reported) * 100

Indicator Name: Percentage of protocol violations or deviations in clinical research studies
Definition: Rate of protocol non-adherence observed in institutional ethics approved clinical trials.
Numerator: Incidence of protocol violations observed in trials
Denominator: Total clinical trial monitoring observations made
Formula: (Protocol violations / Total observations) * 100

Indicator Name: Percentage of serious adverse events (SAE) in clinical research reported to Ethics Committee
Definition: Compliance percentage of serious adverse events in trials reported to IEC within 24 hours.
Numerator: Serious adverse events reported to IEC within 24h
Denominator: Total serious adverse events identified in trials
Formula: (SAE reported within 24h / Total SAE identified) * 100

Indicator Name: Error rates during shift handovers (SBAR Clinical Handover Errors)
Definition: Proportion of audited shift handovers where omission of critical patient info occurred.
Numerator: Errors/omissions detected in shift handovers
Denominator: Total shift handover records reviewed against checklist
Formula: (Handover errors / Total handovers audited) * 100

Indicator Name: Percentage of medical errors due to wrong identification of patient
Definition: Proportion of total reported clinical errors resulting from misidentification of patient.
Numerator: Medical errors reported due to wrong identification
Formula: (Wrong ID errors / Total reported errors) * 100

Indicator Name: Hand hygiene compliance rate across professional categories (WHO 5 Moments)
Definition: Percentage of observed hand hygiene opportunities correctly performed across 5 Moments.
Numerator: Observations where staff complied with hand hygiene
Formula: (Compliant actions / Total observed opportunities) * 100
Data Source: Infection Control Hand Hygiene Surveillance App

Indicator Name: Compliance rate to medication prescription in capitals / Computerized Order Entry (CPOE)
Definition: Percentage of prescriptions in capital letters or 100% compliant via electronic CPOE.
Numerator: Prescriptions in capitals or generated via CPOE
Formula: (CPOE or Capital prescriptions / Total audited prescriptions) * 100

Indicator Name: Percentage of procurement through local purchase
Definition: Financial value of emergency local purchases outside rate contracts as proportion of procurement.
Numerator: Financial value of emergency local purchases
Denominator: Total financial value of all drugs & consumables procured
Formula: (Value of local purchase / Total procurement value) * 100

Indicator Name: Percentage of stockouts for emergency drugs / Average Length of Stay (ALOS)
Definition: Incidence where a mandatory emergency drug on crash cart was out of stock during daily audit; and ALOS.
Numerator: Emergency drug items found stocked out during audits
Denominator: Total emergency drug checklist items monitored
Formula: (Stockout instances / Total monitored items) * 100 | ALOS = Bed days / Discharges
Data Source: Crash Cart Daily Checklist & Pharmacy Stock Log

Indicator Name: Percentage of drugs and consumables rejected before preparation of Goods Receipt Note
Definition: Proportion of received pharmaceutical supplies rejected during physical inspection prior to GRN.
Numerator: Drug / consumable items rejected before GRN
Denominator: Total drug and consumable items received and inspected
Formula: (Rejected items before GRN / Total items received) * 100
Data Source: Pharmacy Goods Inward Inspection Log & GRN System
